title: Free UE5 Skyrim Tutorial Series + Testing Our New Image-to-3D AI Tool
author: Your-Vision
selftext:
Here’s another preview of our ongoing project: rebuilding Skyrim environments in Unreal Engine 5. This isn’t just a visual showcase it’s the foundation of a **free, full-process YouTube tutorial series** we’re creating to teach everything from Gaea heightmaps and terrain texturing to lighting, optimization, and custom asset creation.

As part of this pipeline, we’re also developing our own **image-to-3D AI software** to speed up asset creation and help bring concept images directly into the engine. It’s being built to run locally, focus on usability, and integrate smoothly into projects just like this one.

We’re currently looking for **testers and early feedback** on two fronts:

1. **The tutorial series** for those who want to follow along and learn environment creation in UE5.
2. **Our image-to-3D AI tool** — for artists and developers who want to help shape a new, accessible 3D creation tool.

Whether you're into environment art, game development, AI-assisted creation, or you just love Skyrim — we’d love your input.

**Join the community for early access, updates, and feedback:**  
   **Discord:** [https://discord.gg/cukY5W4Q](https://discord.gg/cukY5W4Q)  
   **YouTube:** [https://www.youtube.com/@YourVisionDev](https://www.youtube.com/@YourVisionDev)

Everything we’re building is meant to be shared, learned from, and made **with** the community.

Thanks for looking questions and feedback are welcome!
